name: apply-gematria
description: Compute and analyze gematria (Hebrew numerical values) using standard, ordinal, and reduced methods. Covers word-to-number conversion, isopsephy comparisons, and interpretive frameworks. Use when computing the numerical value of a Hebrew word or phrase, comparing two words for shared gematria values, studying a biblical verse or divine name for numerical correspondences, or connecting a numerical result to its position on the Tree of Life.
